Payload.$Comment: The Kweebec Nightmare minigame runs its own difficulty; open-world mob scaling is OFF in its instance worlds. This entry IS the per-world kill-switch: say where the rule applies and set Enabled false to exempt those worlds. The contains pattern is deliberate - a live instance is named instance-KweebecNightmare_<Arena>-<uuid>, so the token sits mid-name and only a *Token* form reaches it. Narrow it to one arena with a longer core, e.g. *KweebecNightmare_Barn*.
